purpose: Freeze the exact discovery input contract before executing candidate-family discovery at historical scale. No discovery execution occurs in this artifact -- it defines feature provenance only.

current_measured_population_baselines.note: measured fresh this turn via bounded COUNT(*) queries -- supersedes stale prompt-text figures (1.89M/4.97M)

features.name: CREATE_CREATOR
features.provenance: token_analysis.pf_ws_creator
features.role: distinct from MIGRATION_SIGNER per B2Z-P2G finding
features.coverage: 1,935,806 rows (full token_analysis population, though pf_ws_creator itself may be NULL for some)

features.name: MIGRATION_SIGNER
features.provenance: NONE AT SCALE -- ONLY the 19 B2Z-P2 calibration members have this feature locally (via docs/audits/b2z_p1_stage_outputs_...json, resolve_creator()'s migration-tx sole-signer extraction). Zero local tables track migration-transaction signers for the broader population.
features.role: distinct from CREATE_CREATOR; NOT available at historical scale without live RPC
features.coverage: 19/1,935,806 (0.00098%) -- a genuine, disclosed coverage gap, NOT filled with RPC this milestone
features.eligibility_gate: N/A at scale; only usable for the 19-member calibration cohort itself

features.name: DIRECT_FUNDER
features.provenance: transfer_index.source WHERE destination=CREATE_CREATOR AND block_time<migrated_at AND amount_lamports>0

features.name: DIRECT_FUNDING_SIGNATURE
features.provenance: transfer_index.signature for the selected DIRECT_FUNDER edge

features.name: DIRECT_FUNDING_AMOUNT
features.provenance: transfer_index.amount_lamports

features.name: DIRECT_FUNDING_TIMESTAMP
features.provenance: transfer_index.block_time

features.name: FUNDING_TO_LAUNCH_GAP
features.provenance: computed: pumpfun_migration_verification.migrated_at - transfer_index.block_time
features.role: HIGH/LOW confidence classifier input (existing P1.6/P2-validated 3600s threshold)

features.name: EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE
features.provenance: computed per B2Z-P3B-calibrated policy: HIGH if gap<=3600s AND amount>=0.01 SOL AND no documented extraction failure; else LOW
features.role: primary eligibility gate for discovery use
features.empirical_backing: P2 calibration: HIGH tier 9/9=100% raw-confirmed; LOW tier 0/10 positive -- see docs/audits/b2z_p3b_selective_rpc_policy_calibration_binding.json

features.name: RAW_VERIFICATION_STATE
features.provenance: B2Z-P3A five-category classification (LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DISCOVERY / _RAW_VERIFICATION_OPTIONAL / RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED / MISSING_LOCAL_EVIDENCE / SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED [pending])
features.role: gates whether a relationship may be used for discovery vs. requires selective RPC before trust

features.name: UPSTREAM_SOURCE
features.provenance: second-hop expansion: transfer_index row funding the DIRECT_FUNDER, from SecondHopExpansionBuilder's existing evidence (src/core/second_hop_builder.py) OR freshly computed via the same query shape
features.coverage: to be measured in Workstream D

features.name: UPSTREAM_FUNDING_SIGNATURE_AMOUNT_TIME
features.provenance: same source as UPSTREAM_SOURCE

features.name: SHARED_DIRECT_FUNDER
features.provenance: computed: GROUP BY direct_funder HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT creator) > 1

features.name: SHARED_UPSTREAM_SOURCE
features.provenance: computed: GROUP BY upstream_source HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT direct_funder) > 1

features.name: EP3_TOPOLOGY
features.provenance: existing EP3 Operation Contract identities (src/evidence/discovery/*, Watchtower/three_sw2 shadow corpora)

features.name: EP4_MOTIF
features.provenance: existing EP4.1 canonicalized motifs (14,203 candidates -> 1,379 motifs, docs/evidence_platform/ep4_1_motif_validation.json)

features.name: CREATOR_REUSE
features.provenance: computed: GROUP BY CREATE_CREATOR HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mint) > 1

features.name: MIGRATION_SIGNER_REUSE
features.provenance: ONLY measurable within the 19-member B2Z-P2 cohort (see MIGRATION_SIGNER coverage note above) -- not measurable at historical scale locally

features.name: FUNDING_WALLET_REUSE
features.provenance: computed: GROUP BY DIRECT_FUNDER or UPSTREAM_SOURCE across the discovery population

features.name: TEMPORAL_RECURRENCE
features.provenance: computed: distribution of FUNDING_TO_LAUNCH_GAP and launch timestamps within a candidate cluster
features.role: distinguishes templated/automated patterns from organic ones (existing precedent: OF-P0's 6-way exact-lamport-amount match)

features.name: LAUNCH_RECURRENCE
features.provenance: computed: launches/day within a candidate cluster's date range

features.name: FAN_OUT_FAN_IN
features.provenance: computed: distinct downstream/upstream counts per wallet
features.role: distinguishes distribution hub from a 1:1 funding relationship; existing dust/fan-out review precedent from B2Z-P2's fan_out_review_flag

features.name: CIRCULAR_FUNDING
features.provenance: computed: cycle detection A->B->A within transfer_index for the candidate population
features.role: existing self-funding-scheme detection precedent (docs/CLAUDE.md's documented bwamJzzt example)

features.name: SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_INDICATOR
features.provenance: computed: fan-out wallet with high launch count but ambiguous 1:1 role, OR the B2Z-P2G-qualified 'shared migration signer, not creator' pattern applied at whatever scale MIGRATION_SIGNER coverage permits
features.role: downgrades a candidate from STRONG to SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_CLUSTER

features.name: RAW_CACHE_AVAILABILITY
features.provenance: tf_transaction_cache via src/acquisition/tf_cache_lookup.py (read-only)
features.role: informs selective-RPC queue prioritization -- prior measurement showed near-zero overlap for the B2Z-P2/P3A population specifically; re-checked per-candidate-family in Workstream S

features.name: EVIDENCE_CONFLICTS
features.provenance: computed: e.g. a direct funder with two candidate creators at conflicting/impossible timestamps, or CREATE_CREATOR disagreement across duplicate detection paths
features.role: flags a relationship for IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than silent resolution

role_separation_mandate.implementation_approach: adapter/projection layer only (src/discovery/local_operation_discovery_projection.py, built this milestone) -- reads existing tables, computes derived features, writes to NEW discovery-specific tables only, never mutates token_analysis/transfer_index/pumpfun_migration_verification/creator_funding_queue

evidence_eligibility_policy_reused_verba.HIGH_confidence_criteria: temporal gap <= 3600 seconds AND amount >= 0.01 SOL (10,000,000 lamports) AND no documented extraction failure (creator_funding_queue.status != 'failed')
evidence_eligibility_policy_reused_verba.empirical_validation: 9/9 = 100% raw-confirmed in B2Z-P2 -- HIGH-confidence evidence MAY be used for discovery without further verification
evidence_eligibility_policy_reused_verba.LOW_confidence_treatment: MUST NOT be silently treated as proven -- classified per B2Z-P3A's five categories (RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED / MISSING_LOCAL_EVIDENCE / SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED) and flagged, not used to assert a confirmed family membership on its own
